_doc: Binds game RPCs (player.base.<name>) to backend actions. Fill this from local_update/server_data/unknown_rpcs.json after clicking a button in the lobby. See backend_server/README.md -> 'Binding a button'.

routes._note_startup: Calls the lobby makes on entry that need no reply offline are acknowledged quietly.

buyDtsHallProp._note: Depot / store "Purchase" of one hall prop (weapon skin, outfit...): base.buyDtsHallProp(hallPropID, cashCoupons, logStr). The lobby hook adds its price (mall_utils.getDtsHallPropBuyCurrencyID / Price).

queryAvailableActivity._note: UIMain.on_enter on every lobby entry; {} is 'no active events' (the shape of a non-empty answer is unknown).

routes._note_battleground: The battleground player asks for its weapon components as soon as it enters (iGunComponent.onRequestInitData(gunCompPkg, gunSlotsList)); empty is a player with no guns yet, which is what the local battle host has.
routes._note_start_button: START (UIModes._doGoMatch) asks getOpenMaintenanceFightTipFlag first and goes no further until onGetOpenMaintenanceFightTipFlag comes back; popTip 0 = no maintenance, carry on. The delay lets the click return first: the reply opens screens. A quiet ack here makes the START button do nothing at all.

setPortrait._note: Sent with '0' on every lobby entry; acknowledged quiet (portrait sharing is the profile area's).

sSyncSettingDataToServer._note: Settings live in the game's own settings files (kept per PC by the hook); the online server only stored them. Not pushed back (cSyncSettingDataToClient eval()s into Globals.settings). New hooks drop it as quiet; older clients still send it.

routes._note_supply: SUPPLY RPCs (openSupplyBox, openMultipleSupplyBox, queryAvailableSupplement, ...) are Python handlers in backend_server/supplement_rpc.py; do not add routes for them here (a route wins over a handler).

requestDecomposeAppearance._note: Depot "Convert Repeats": base.requestDecomposeAppearance([appearanceID...]). The lobby hook adds the game's shard rates; rlDecomposed (a lobby-hook callback) removes the copies and plays the shards animation.

requestDecomposeAllRepeation._note: Convert every repeat: the lobby hook names them (player.getDecomposeAppearance).

composeItem._note: Depot "Compose" with shards: base.composeItem(appearanceID). The lobby hook adds the compose currency and price; onItemComposed shows the "you got" screen.

setHasAlreadyShowMonthSupply._note: UIMonthlySupplyPackage.startMonthSupplyAnimCoro_NoUI after the monthly intro: remembered per account for this PH month, so UIMain.on_enter stops auto-opening the panel.

finishRetAct527TaskFromClient._note: The online server only recorded it.

rlSettleDepot._note: Lobby hook (not a game call): currency props become currency, extra copies of appearances that cannot be converted are dropped.

requestDtsLevelAward._note: Benefits > Level Award: one Get click claims every reached, unclaimed level pack (Claim All; the lobby hook opens the packs - ExpLevelTable levelAward - and sends levels {level: items}). rlLevelAwards first: onRequestDtsLevelAward appends $level itself. The claimed list is a lobby prop (welfare.level_props); a refusal re-syncs it.

requestDtsSigninAward._note: 7-day login (UIDtsSign): claim today's reward; days follow the server clock in Philippine time. The reply's props carry the new state (rlWelfare); a refusal (already_signed, week_done) re-syncs the hook's copy and the screen (rlWelfareSync).

rlWelfareState._note: Lobby hook (not a game call): login days, today's claim and claimed level packs.

rlActivityState._note: Lobby hook (not a game call): active activities, calendar version, version this account has seen.

rlActivitySeen._note: Lobby hook: the Activity panel was opened; clears NEW! for this calendar.

onNewPlayerTaskMsg._note: UILimitWelfareController.on_enter notification (TaskMsgType OPEN_TIMELIMIT_ACTIVITY); nothing to answer.

requireRefreshSeasonBountyInfoStatus._note: Season Bounty has ended: no red points.

reqSeasonBountyCheckSign._note: Season Bounty cash claims went to rulesofsurvivalgame.com (gone); no onReqSeasonBountyCheckSign, so no dead web page.
reqSeasonBountyCheckSign.tip: Season Bounty has ended - there are no cash rewards to claim.

routes._note_demon_hunter: UIGuiMieTurnable (lobby Demon Hunter tile) is a limited-time lottery wheel whose draws the revival does not run (its version, currency and rules are unknown); the lobby hook fills the wheel from the game's own tables. A draw is acknowledged with a tip and nothing is charged.

requestDtsLTDoLottery.tip: Demon Hunter draws have ended - nothing was charged.

requestDtsLTDoAdvanceLottery.tip: Demon Hunter draws have ended - nothing was charged.

requireRankList._note: DATA leaderboards: one board of the server (points / wins / kills), paged; rlRankList hands it to the game callback of its kind.

requireRankInfo._note: DATA leaderboards: your own row of a board.

routes._note_profile: Another player's card / personal space, by gid, from the database (features/ranking.py public_profile): never the asker's own data. The hook asks these only for other gids; your own card stays local.

requireBaseInfo._note: Meet / STATS card: onGetBaseInfo(gid, nickname, isFriend, score, serverID, identifyTagID, dtsLevel, nationalFlag).

requireRecordData._note: STATS records by RecordTypeToName name; rlRecordData lets the hook fill the types the player never played (zero records).

queryPersonalInfo._note: UIPersonalSpace of another player: queryPersonalInfoCB(gid, data); data keys as _getPersonInfo builds them.

routes._note_credit: Friends > Meet profile tabs (features/profile.py), for any gid: credit (full credit, Diamond status, nothing to claim), the best-weapon title from the per-weapon battle totals the lobby saves (lobby weaponStats), TanTan sex / picture count kept in character data. Intimate relationships, marriage and personal-space comments are not kept yet: an empty but valid answer, never the asker's own data. rl* callbacks are finished by the lobby hook (it knows the game's intimate IDs and weapon table).

queryCreditStatus._note: queryCreditStatusCB takes no arguments: the status arrives as the online push syncCreditStatus(status, coupletsTime, gifts).

requestIntimateRelationshipInfo._note: Your own list (UIMeetMainPage.on_enter, enterHall): rlIntimateInfo -> onUpdateIntimateRelationship(info, requests).

requestMessageForMarriage._note: The gids are echoed as sent: callbackFillMessagePanel compares them with its own pair.

changeTantanSex._note: PlayerAthlete.updateTantanSex sets player.tantanSex; without it the Meet page sent this again on every visit.

requestMeetInfo._note: Not a game RPC: the lobby hook asks it for meethttp.httpMeetMyInfo (Meet page Data), so the page reads this database locally and online.

updateIsIntimateRelationshipVisibleInTea._note: A setting the game repeats with the same value; nothing reads it back.

updatePlayerLBSData._note: updatePlayerLBSData(adminCode, subAdminCode), e.g. ('UN', ''): echoed back as the strings the rank list expects.

getVipReward._note: UIVipPrivilege.onClickGet: getVipReward(vipType, level). iVip.onGetVipReward shows the props; syncVipInfo refreshes the levels, red dots and the screen (features/vip.py).

openNewMonthcardMain._note: UINewMonthCard.on_enter(addVisit): no card bought (top-up is disabled). onOpenNewMonthcardFirst(gotLuckyCoin=True) -> refreshNormalEnterUI, the normal entry screen whose game buttons only show the buy-first tips (False would start the first-visit coin game, whose bets are not served).

queryAvailableHalfMonthPackage._note: UILimitWelfareController / UITimeLimitActivityHalfMonthPackage: no half-month packs on sale (top-up is disabled). Both args stay dicts: iLimitPackage.canBuySpringPack tests `packID in halfMonthPackageBuyTimes`.

queryAvailbleMonthPayRebateAwards._note: UILimitWelfareController: no monthly top-up rebate (top-up is disabled). iPay.canGetMonthPayRebateAward iterates monthPayRebateAwardInfo (a dict).
